title: Air Starter Motor — Removal

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the air starter motor from the accessory gearbox pad, including the oil catchment arrangement and the clutch witness mark record that has to be taken through the shroud aperture first.

sections.purpose: To remove the air starter motor from the accessory gearbox pad for replacement or for clutch inspection.
sections.job_setup_note: The engine must have been shut down for at least sixty minutes and the bleed system depressurised. The fan cowl must be open and supported. An oil catchment tray is needed under the gearbox pad because the pad seal will release residual oil. Two persons are needed. Where the shroud has the larger aperture, the clutch witness mark must be read and recorded before the starter is disturbed.
sections.procedure: WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE BLEED SYSTEM IS DEPRESSURISED AND THAT THE ENGINE HAS BEEN SHUT DOWN FOR AT LEAST SIXTY MINUTES. THE STARTER DUCT AND CASING REMAIN HOT AND THE DUCT MAY BE PRESSURISED. Put the safety barriers in position. Remove the electrical power and put the warning notices in position. Open the fan cowl and install the hold-open rod. Put the oil catchment tray under the accessory gearbox pad. Read the clutch witness mark through the shroud aperture and record it. Remove the cranking shroud ASDE222426-98. Disconnect the electrical connector at the start valve and cap it. Loosen the clamp PE187919-09 at the starter air inlet and remove the nozzle assembly HOL790179-18. CAUTION: SUPPORT THE STARTER BEFORE THE LAST PAD BOLT IS REMOVED. THE UNIT WEIGHS ABOUT ELEVEN KILOGRAMS AND WILL DROP ONTO THE GEARBOX HOUSING. Remove the pad bolts EN290030-3C in a diagonal sequence, supporting the starter throughout. Break the pad seal and withdraw the starter squarely off the drive shaft. Cap the gearbox pad immediately. Drain the residual oil into the catchment tray and record the quantity. Examine the drive shaft splines for wear and for spragging witness and record the finding.
sections.close_out: Make sure that the gearbox pad is capped and that the air inlet duct is capped and supported. Remove the oil catchment tray and dispose of the drained oil under the operator procedure. Make sure that no tools or hardware remain in the nacelle. Close the fan cowl if no further work is planned. Record the removal, the serial number, the clutch witness mark, the drained oil quantity and the spline condition.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The witness mark step applies only where the larger shroud aperture is fitted, post MOD-111356.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the bleed system is depressurised and that the engine has been shut down for at least sixty minutes.
Support the starter before the last pad bolt is removed.
Put the oil catchment tray in position before the pad seal is broken.
